skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence, ideology and basic philosophies of marketing
Understand the role and position of marketing; the relationship between the marketing function and other function
Understand the marketing implementation process towards making effective marketing decisions
Understand the role of information in marketing decision making and how to gather it
Understand the basis for making marketing decisions is the factors belonging to the marketing environment, including customers, micro factors and macro factors
Understand the essence and how to make strategic decisions in marketing through the STP formula
Understand the essence and the role of basic marketing tools through the 4Ps formula; analyse marketing activities in the organization/business
Demonstrate information-gathering skills and generally analyse marketing activities in a specific business
Understand the requirement to get social context; have professional ethics and social responsibility
